$ stock count bolts
bolts: 12 in main
[exit 0]

$ stock count --help
Usage: stock count [options] ITEM

Count an item in a warehouse.

Arguments:
      ITEM  Item to count.

Options:
  -w, --warehouse string  Warehouse of the item.  default "main", env STOCK_COUNT_WAREHOUSE, key count.warehouse

Global options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env STOCK_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
[exit 0]
